Each day trains the full body with a kettlebell squat, press, hinge and row, so the week covers everything your kit allows.","title":"Kettlebell Full Body","days":[{"name":"Day 1","exercises":[{"key":"kettlebell-goblet-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows inside the knees, chest tall."},{"key":"kettlebell-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Ribs down, press straight up."},{"key":"kettlebell-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hips back, bell close to the legs."},{"key":"single-arm-kettlebell-row","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pull to the hip, keep the torso still."}]},{"name":"Day 2","exercises":[{"key":"kettlebell-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hold the bell at the chest."},{"key":"single-arm-kettlebell-floor-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbow at about 45 degrees."},{"key":"kettlebell-swing","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Snap the hips, arms just guide it."},{"key":"renegade-kettlebell-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hips square, no rocking."}]},{"name":"Day 3","exercises":[{"key":"kettlebell-sumo-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Stand tall at the top, brace before each rep."},{"key":"single-arm-kettlebell-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep the wrist stacked over the elbow."},{"key":"kettlebell-step-up","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive through the working leg."},{"key":"kettlebell-gorilla-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Feet wide, pull straight back."}]}],"unmet":[]}
